tables.description: One row per trial from ClinicalTrials.gov: industry-sponsored, interventional, phase 2 or 3, primary completion 2015 to 2023.

columns.name: nct_id
columns.description: ClinicalTrials.gov ID, e.g. NCT01234567. Primary key; joins every other table.

columns.name: title
columns.description: Brief title of the trial.

columns.name: sponsor
columns.description: Lead sponsor name exactly as registered. Use ILIKE '%name%' to match: spelling varies.

columns.name: sponsor_class
columns.description: Lead sponsor class. Always INDUSTRY in this snapshot.

columns.name: phase
columns.description: Phase, e.g. PHASE2, PHASE3, or PHASE2/PHASE3 for combined trials.

columns.name: conditions
columns.description: List of conditions studied (VARCHAR[]). Search with list_contains or array_to_string(conditions, ' ') ILIKE.

columns.name: interventions
columns.description: List of intervention names (VARCHAR[]), including placebo and devices.

columns.name: drug_names
columns.description: Drug and biologic intervention names without placebo (VARCHAR[]). Use these to search filings.

columns.name: overall_status
columns.description: Registry status: TERMINATED, WITHDRAWN, SUSPENDED or COMPLETED.

columns.name: why_stopped
columns.description: The sponsor's free-text reason for stopping, as registered. NULL when completed or left blank.

columns.name: start_date
columns.description: Trial start date (month-only dates become the 1st).

columns.name: primary_completion_date
columns.description: Date the last participant was examined for the primary outcome.

columns.name: completion_date
columns.description: Date the whole trial ended.

columns.name: enrollment
columns.description: Number of participants enrolled (actual for stopped trials).

columns.name: has_results
columns.description: TRUE if summary results are posted on ClinicalTrials.gov.

columns.name: results_first_post_date
columns.description: Date results were first posted. NULL if never posted.

columns.name: last_update_date
columns.description: Date the registry record was last updated.

tables.description: Derived columns per trial, built by scripts/build_snapshot.py. Join on nct_id.

columns.name: nct_id
columns.description: Trial ID; joins trials.nct_id.

columns.name: results_due_date
columns.description: Approximate results deadline: primary completion + 365 days. An approximation, not a legal deadline.

columns.name: results_posted
columns.description: TRUE if results are posted on ClinicalTrials.gov.

columns.name: days_late
columns.description: If posted: days after results_due_date it was posted (0 = on time). If not posted and past due: days overdue as of the snapshot date. NULL otherwise.

columns.name: stopped
columns.description: TRUE if status is TERMINATED, WITHDRAWN or SUSPENDED.

columns.name: why_stopped_category
columns.description: Category of the stated reason: safety, efficacy, business/strategic, enrollment, other, or blank.

columns.name: why_stopped_method
columns.description: How the category was assigned: keyword, llm, blank, or default.

tables.description: Sponsor name to SEC CIK for publicly listed sponsors. Private sponsors have no row.

columns.name: sponsor
columns.description: Sponsor name as in trials.sponsor.

columns.name: cik
columns.description: SEC Central Index Key, 10 digits zero-padded.

columns.name: ticker
columns.description: Stock ticker.

columns.name: company
columns.description: Company name in SEC's list.

columns.name: match_score
columns.description: Fuzzy match score 0 to 100 between the normalized names. Only rows >= the threshold are kept.

tables.description: SEC 8-K filings from a matched sponsor within 120 days of a stopped trial's dates that mention its NCT ID or drug name.

columns.name: nct_id
columns.description: Trial the filing was matched to.

columns.name: cik
columns.description: Filer's CIK.

columns.name: accession
columns.description: SEC accession number, e.g. 0001193125-21-123456.

columns.name: form
columns.description: Form type, e.g. 8-K.

columns.name: filed_date
columns.description: Date filed with the SEC.

columns.name: url
columns.description: URL of the matching document in the EDGAR archive.

columns.name: matched_terms
columns.description: Search terms used (NCT ID and drug names).

columns.name: snippet
columns.description: About 600 characters of the filing around the first matching term. NULL if the document could not be read.

tables.description: PubMed articles linked to a trial.

columns.name: nct_id
columns.description: Trial ID.

columns.name: pmid
columns.description: PubMed ID.

columns.name: link_type
columns.description: How it was linked: ctgov_result (sponsor listed it as a results paper), ctgov_derived or pubmed_si (the article lists the NCT ID), europepmc_mention (text mentions the NCT ID).

columns.name: title
columns.description: Article title.

columns.name: journal
columns.description: Journal name.

columns.name: pub_date
columns.description: Publication date.

columns.name: url
columns.description: PubMed URL.

tables.description: One row per table: when the snapshot was built and how many rows each table has.

columns.name: table_name
columns.description: Table name.

columns.name: row_count
columns.description: Rows in that table.

columns.name: built_at
columns.description: Snapshot build date (UTC).

columns.name: scope
columns.description: What the snapshot covers.
enum_values: ClinicalTrials.gov industry-sponsored interventional phase 2/3 trials, primary completion 2015-01-01 to 2023-12-31, status TERMINATED/WITHDRAWN/SUSPENDED/COMPLETED
